definition_zh: 舒服的；舒适的；安逸的；宽裕的
definition_en: making you feel relaxed and free of pain; having enough money for a good life
core_image: 陷进软沙发里的那种放松感
scene: 上完一整天体育课回到家，我换上拖鞋瘫进了大沙发。Of all the seats in our house, this old sofa is truly comfortable.
sceneCN: 这里 comfortable 是「舒服的」（第 1 个义项：身体放松、不难受）；句意是这张旧沙发是家里最舒服的座位。

derivatives.zh: 由词根 comfort 加名词后缀构成，义为「舒适；安慰」
由 comfortable 加副词后缀 -ly 构成，义为「舒服地」
由否定前缀 un- 构成，义为「不舒服的；不自在的」
由 comfort 加 -ing 构成，义为「令人安慰的」

senses.title: Pleasant to sit in, wear or touch
senses.definition: making you feel relaxed because it is soft and easy on the body
senses.definitionCN: 让人放松，因为柔软、贴身不难受
senses.example: These running shoes are very comfortable for long walks.
senses.exampleCN: 这双跑鞋走长路很舒服。
senses.why: The core image is sinking into something soft, so anything soft and easy on the body earns this word.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是陷进柔软的东西里，所以凡是让身体放松不费劲的东西都可以用它形容。

senses.title: Feeling relaxed and not worried
senses.definition: feeling calm and free from worry or embarrassment in a place or situation
senses.definitionCN: 在某个地方或场合感到平静，不担心、不尴尬
senses.example: I did not feel comfortable answering questions in front of the whole class.
senses.exampleCN: 在全班面前回答问题让我很不自在。
senses.why: When the body relaxes, the mind often follows, so the word stretched from physical ease to emotional ease.
senses.whyCN: 身体放松时心情往往也跟着放松，所以这个词从身体上的舒适延伸到了心理上的自在。

senses.title: Having enough money without worry
senses.definition: having enough money to live well without financial problems
senses.definitionCN: 钱够用，生活没有经济压力
senses.example: Her grandparents live a comfortable life in a small town.
senses.exampleCN: 她的祖父母在小镇上过着宽裕的生活。
senses.why: A life free of hardship feels like a soft chair for the whole family, so the image of ease grew into wealth.
senses.whyCN: 没有艰辛的生活就像全家人坐上了软椅子，所以「安逸」的意象延伸成了「宽裕」。

intro.en: Comfortable traces back to a Latin verb that meant to strengthen greatly.
intro.cn: comfortable 可以追溯到拉丁语动词，本义是「大大加强」。

items.en: The Latin verb confortare meant to strengthen much, built on com- (intensive) and fortis (strong).
items.cn: 拉丁语动词 confortare 意为大大加强，由加强语气的 com- 加 fortis（强壮的）构成。

items.en: Old French carried it over as conforter, meaning to comfort or console.
items.cn: 古法语把它变成 conforter，意为安慰、抚慰。

items.en: English took comfort in the thirteenth century, first meaning strengthening or aid.
items.cn: 英语在十三世纪吸收 comfort，最初指支持、帮助。

items.en: The adjective comfortable followed, at first meaning strengthening or cheering, then pleasant to the body.
items.cn: 形容词 comfortable 随之出现，起初指鼓舞人心的，后来指身体上舒服的。

items.en: Today comfortable covers soft chairs, easy feelings and a secure income.
items.cn: 如今 comfortable 可以形容软椅子、轻松的心情，也形容安稳的收入。

note.en: These words belong to the comfort family or describe pleasant, relaxed feelings.
note.cn: 这些词属于 comfort 词族，或同样描述轻松愉悦的感受。

entries.definition: ease and freedom from pain; also a verb meaning to console
entries.definitionCN: 舒适；安慰（动词义为抚慰）

entries.definition: making someone feel less sad or worried
spacious and roomy; only vaguely similar in sense, different root
entries.definitionCN: 宽敞的（词源不同，仅意义相近）

entries.definition: warm and comfortable, often in a small place

normalIntro.en: Use the comfort family and daily objects to lock the spelling in.
normalIntro.cn: 用 comfort 词族和身边的物件把拼写记牢。

normal.en: comfort + able = comfortable: able to give comfort.
normal.cn: comfort（舒适）+ able（能够的）＝让人能够感到舒适的东西。

normal.en: Note the hidden for: com-for-table, not comfrot.
normal.cn: 注意中间藏着 for：com-for-table，别拼成 comfrot。

normal.en: The opposite adds un-: uncomfortable.
normal.cn: 反义词加 un-：uncomfortable（不舒服）。

normal.en: The adverb swaps -able for -ably: comfortably.
normal.cn: 副词把 -able 换成 -ably：comfortably。

normal.en: Pronunciation shortcut: UK speech often hides the second syllable, KUMF-tuh-bl.
normal.cn: 发音捷径：英式口语常吞掉一个音节，读成 KUMF-tuh-bl。

abstract.en: Picture sinking into a giant pillow after school; nothing hurts, nothing presses.
abstract.cn: 想象放学后陷进一个巨大的枕头里，哪儿都不疼、哪儿都不压。

abstract.en: Feel the ease of a warm sweater on a cold day; that ease is the word.
abstract.cn: 感受冷天里套上暖毛衣的那种轻松感，这种轻松就是这个词。

abstract.en: A family with savings sits calmly at dinner; no worry, so a comfortable life.
abstract.cn: 有积蓄的一家人安静地吃饭，没有烦恼，这就是宽裕的生活。

examples.en: My new school shoes are more comfortable than the old ones.
examples.cn: 我的新校鞋比旧的那双舒服。

examples.en: Please make yourselves comfortable while we wait for the teacher.
examples.cn: 等老师的时候大家别拘束。

examples.en: It is warm today, so the scarf feels uncomfortable.
examples.cn: 今天很暖和，戴围巾觉得不自在。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「康福特布」——又宽又软的布料让人「康康地舒服」

root: 来自拉丁语 confortare（大大加强），com- 为加强语气前缀，fortis 意为「强壮的」；经古法语 conforter 进入英语，先指「鼓舞、支持」，后指「身体舒适」。

sensesIntro.en: The word moves from soft objects to easy feelings to a secure life.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个词从柔软的物件，到轻松的心情，再到安稳宽裕的生活。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: sinking into something soft and safe
core.cn: 核心意象：陷进柔软安全的东西里

branches.cn: 软椅子、鞋子和床带来的舒服
没有经济烦恼的宽裕生活

branches.en: Physical ease sliding into mental ease
branches.cn: 身体舒适延伸为心理放松

intro.en: Comfortable is built from a Latin root plus an adjective suffix.
intro.cn: comfortable 由拉丁词根加形容词后缀构成。

latinIntro.en: The Latin root fortis means strong, as in fortress.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词根 fortis 意为强壮的，如 fortress（堡垒）。

items.exampleCN: compare（比较）：把东西放到一起看

definition_en: an area of land with its own government; land away from towns
core_image: 一片有自己的政府和边界的土地
scene: 升旗仪式上，我们大声唱着国歌，心里特别自豪。Every student should love his or her country.
sceneCN: 这里 country 是「国家」（第 1 个义项：有政府、有边界的一片土地）；句意是每个学生都应热爱自己的国家。

derivatives.zh: 由 country 加 side 构成，义为「乡下；农村地区」
由 country 加 man 构成，义为「同胞；同乡」
拼写相近但来源不同，义为「郡；县」

senses.title: A nation with its own government
senses.definition: an area of land whose people have one government and usually share a language
senses.definitionCN: 一片土地，上面的人民由同一个政府管理，通常说同一种语言
senses.example: China is a large country with a long history.
senses.exampleCN: 中国是一个历史悠久的大国。
senses.why: The core image is a bordered land under one rule, so any such nation is a country.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是一块有边界、由一个政权管理的土地，所以这样的国家都叫 country。

senses.title: Land away from towns
senses.definition: open land outside cities and towns, with fields and farms
senses.definitionCN: 城市之外有田野和农场的开阔地带
senses.example: We spent the weekend hiking in the country.
senses.exampleCN: 我们周末去乡下徒步了。
senses.why: From any big city, the whole land beyond the walls is the country, so the word also points to rural land.
senses.whyCN: 从任何大城市看，城墙之外的大地就是 the country，所以这个词也指乡村地区。

senses.title: The land or region itself
senses.definition: the land itself, especially when described by its features
senses.definitionCN: 土地本身，尤其用于描写地貌
senses.example: They drove through beautiful hilly country.
senses.exampleCN: 他们开车穿过美丽的丘陵地带。
senses.why: Because a country is first of all a piece of land, speakers also use it for land shaped by hills or rivers.
senses.whyCN: 因为 country 本义是土地，所以人们也用它指有山丘、河流特点的地带。

intro.en: Country comes from a Latin phrase about the land lying against something.
intro.cn: country 来自拉丁语短语，本义与「对着、位于对面的土地」有关。

items.en: The Latin phrase contra terram meant against the land, with contra meaning opposite.
items.cn: 拉丁语短语 contra terram 意为对着土地，contra 意为对面、相对。

items.en: Old French made cuntrée, meaning the region lying around, a district.
items.cn: 古法语造出 cuntrée，指周边的地区、地带。

items.en: English borrowed contree in the thirteenth century, meaning a district or area of land.
items.cn: 英语在十三世纪借入 contree，指地区、土地。

items.en: Later it narrowed to mean the land of a nation with its own ruler.
items.cn: 后来词义收窄，指由自己君主统治的国家土地。

items.en: Today country means both a nation and, with the, rural land.
items.cn: 如今 country 既指国家，加定冠词时指乡村。

note.en: These words name lands and places, or sound close to country.
note.cn: 这些词都指土地与地方，或与 country 拼写读音相近。

entries.definition: a district for local government; spelling differs, similar source
entries.definitionCN: 郡；县（拼写不同，来源相近）

entries.definition: someone from the same country or rural area
a table for service or to oppose; only sounds similar, different root
entries.definitionCN: 柜台；相反（读音相近，词源不同）

entries.definition: a country and its people seen as a whole
a country or a political unit
a small community in the country

normalIntro.en: Break the word into parts and connect each sense to a picture.
normalIntro.cn: 把词拆开，给每个义项配一个画面。

normal.en: country = count + ry: count many nations, each is a country.
normal.cn: country 可联想 count（数）+ ry：数一数世界上有多少个国家。

normal.en: countryside keeps the whole word plus side: land at the side of towns.
normal.cn: countryside 就是整个词加 side：城市旁边的土地，即乡下。

normal.en: Plural rule: y changes to i, countries.
normal.cn: 复数规则：y 变 i 加 es，countries。

normal.en: In the country means in the countryside, not inside a nation.
normal.cn: in the country 指在乡下，不是在国家内部。

normal.en: Country music grew up among rural singers, hence the name.
normal.cn: 乡村音乐由乡村歌手唱红，所以得名 country music。

abstract.en: Picture a map with clear lines; every line holds one flag and one government.
abstract.cn: 想象画着清晰边界的地图，每条边界内有一面国旗、一个政府。

abstract.en: Outside the city wall, fields run to the horizon; that view is the country.
abstract.cn: 城墙外田野一直铺到天边，那片景色就是 the country。

abstract.en: Feel pride when the anthem plays; the feeling points at your country.
abstract.cn: 国歌响起时的自豪感，指向的就是你的国家。

examples.en: France is a European country famous for its food.
examples.cn: 法国是欧洲一个以美食闻名的国家。

examples.en: My grandparents live in the country, far from the noisy city.
examples.cn: 我祖父母住在乡下，离喧闹的城市很远。

examples.en: Athletes from every country joined the games.
examples.cn: 来自每个国家的运动员都参加了运动会。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「康川」——康庄大道通向一个个「国家」和乡川

root: 来自拉丁语 contra（对面）+ terra（土地），经古法语 cuntrée 进入英语，先指「周边地区」，后固定指「国家」；the country 特指乡村。

sensesIntro.en: From a bordered nation to open rural land, one word covers both.
sensesIntro.cn: 从有边界的国家到开阔的乡野，一个词覆盖两个意思。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a big piece of land with a border
core.cn: 核心意象：一块带边界的大土地

intro.en: Country hides an old Latin phrase inside its spelling.
intro.cn: country 的拼写里藏着一个古老的拉丁语短语。

latinIntro.en: The Latin root terra means earth or land, as in territory.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词根 terra 意为大地、土地，如 territory（领土）。

items.exampleCN: contrast（对比）：把两者放在一起对着看

items.example: terrace: a flat piece of ground

definition_en: land outside cities and towns, with fields, farms and villages
core_image: 城市尽头连绵的田野和村庄
scene: 秋游的大巴驶出城市，窗外出现了金黄的稻田和安静的小村。The countryside looks beautiful in autumn.
sceneCN: 这里 countryside 是「乡下」（第 1 个义项：城市外的田野地带）；句意是秋天的乡村看起来很美。

derivatives.zh: 基础词，义为「国家；乡村」
同义形容词，义为「农村的；乡下的」
反义词，义为「城市的」

senses.title: Rural land with fields and villages
senses.titleCN: 有田野和村庄的农村地区
senses.definition: open land outside towns where people farm and live in small villages
senses.definitionCN: 城镇之外的开放土地，人们在那里种地和住在小村庄里
senses.example: The children drew the countryside with green hills and small houses.
senses.exampleCN: 孩子们画了有青山和小房子的乡村。
senses.why: The compound joins country with side, so it means the land at the side of towns, the rural area.
senses.whyCN: 复合词由 country 加 side 构成，意思是城镇旁边的那一侧土地，也就是农村地区。

senses.title: Country scenery as a whole
senses.definition: the whole view of rural land, often praised for beauty
senses.definitionCN: 乡村景色整体，常被称赞为美丽
senses.example: Painters love the soft light of the countryside in the morning.
senses.exampleCN: 画家喜爱清晨乡村柔和的光线。
senses.why: When the land is seen as a picture rather than fields to work, the word points at the scenery itself.
senses.whyCN: 当土地被当作画面而非耕作的田地来看时，这个词就指向风光本身。

intro.en: Countryside is a compound that grew inside English from older parts.
intro.cn: countryside 是在英语内部由旧成分长成的复合词。

items.en: Its deepest part goes back to contra terram, against the land, from Latin.
items.cn: 它最深的部分可追溯到拉丁语 contra terram，意为对着土地。

items.en: Old French shaped cuntrée, a region of land.
items.cn: 古法语形成 cuntrée，指一片地区。

items.en: English kept contree, later country, meaning land or nation.
items.cn: 英语保留了 contree，后写作 country，意为土地或国家。

items.en: The noun side meant the edge or part next to something.
items.cn: 名词 side 意为旁边、一侧。

items.en: The compound countryside appeared in the seventeenth century and stuck, since the and the country already meant rural land.
items.cn: 复合词 countryside 出现于十七世纪并沿用至今，因为 the country 已可指乡村。

note.en: These words name rural places or share the country spelling.
note.cn: 这些词指乡村地方，或与 country 拼写相关。

entries.definition: a nation; with the, rural land
a local government area; only spelled a bit alike
land beside the sea, built like countryside
a person from the same country
the countryside seen as a region
the outer parts of a town

normalIntro.en: Build the compound aloud and picture each part.
normalIntro.cn: 把复合词念出来，想象每个部分。

normal.en: country + side: the land at the side of the city.
normal.cn: country + side：城市旁边的那片土地。

normal.en: Compare seaside, bedside, roadside: side joins places.
normal.cn: 对比 seaside、bedside、roadside：side 常用来组地点词。

normal.en: In the countryside always uses the.
normal.cn: 短语 in the countryside 一定要带 the。

normal.en: Rural is the formal cousin, countryside is the everyday word.
normal.cn: rural 是正式的同义词，countryside 是日常用语。

normal.en: Remember it never means a country; it means farmland and hills.
normal.cn: 记住它不是国家，而是农田与山丘。

abstract.en: Picture standing at the city edge: on one side, bricks; on the other, endless green.
abstract.cn: 想象站在城市边缘：一边是砖墙，另一边是无尽的绿色。

abstract.en: Hear the quiet: birds and wind, not traffic; that quiet is the countryside.
abstract.cn: 听那份安静：鸟鸣和风声而非车流，那份安静就是乡村。

abstract.en: Smell fresh hay after rain; the smell belongs to the countryside.
abstract.cn: 雨后闻到新鲜的干草味，这味道属于乡村。

examples.en: We rode our bikes through the countryside last Sunday.
examples.cn: 上周日我们骑车穿过了乡村。

examples.en: Many city families take holidays in the countryside.
examples.cn: 许多城市家庭去乡下度假。

examples.en: The countryside near my hometown is full of apple trees.
examples.cn: 我家乡附近的农村种满了苹果树。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「康川赛德」——康庄的乡川就在城的那一边

root: 由 country（源自拉丁语 contra + terra）与 side（古英语，旁边）在英语内部复合而成，十七世纪起用来指城镇之外的农村地区。

sensesIntro.en: One compound covers both the rural land and its scenery.
sensesIntro.cn: 一个复合词既指农村土地，也指乡村风光。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: green land just beyond the city edge
core.cn: 核心意象：城市边缘之外的绿色土地

branches.en: Land and its look as one

branches.cn: 画家与徒步者追寻的对象

branches.en: Where farms and quiet roads are

intro.en: Countryside shows how English compounds two old words into one.
intro.cn: countryside 展示了英语如何把两个旧词复合成一个词。

latinIntro.en: Its Latin root terra means land, shared with territory.
latinIntro.cn: 它的拉丁词根 terra 意为土地，与 territory 同源。

definition_en: two people or things together, especially two people in love; a small number
core_image: 两个连在一起的东西，像并排的椅子
scene: 公园里，一对老夫妇手牵手慢慢散步，有说有笑。An elderly couple walks in the park every morning.
sceneCN: 这里 couple 是「夫妇；一对」（第 1 个义项：两个人或物成双出现）；句意是一对老夫妇每天早晨在公园散步。

derivatives.zh: 由 couple 加小后缀构成，义为「对句；双行诗」
由动词加 -ing 构成，义为「联结；联轴器」
复数形式，义为「多对；多组」

senses.title: Two people together, often in love or married
senses.titleCN: 成双的两个人，常指夫妇或情侣
senses.definition: two people who are together, especially husband and wife or two people in love
senses.definitionCN: 在一起的两个人，尤指夫妻或恋人
senses.example: The young couple took photos before the old school gate.
senses.exampleCN: 这对年轻情侣在校门前拍了照。
senses.why: The core image is two joined as one unit, so two people who act as one get called a couple.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是两个连成一个整体，所以像一体一样行动的两个人就被称为 a couple。

senses.title: A small number, two or a few
senses.definition: a small number of things or people, more than one but not many
senses.definitionCN: 数量不多，不止一个但也不多
senses.example: Give me a couple of minutes to find my key.
senses.exampleCN: 给我两分钟找钥匙。
senses.why: When two became the common way to say a handful, the word stretched to mean any few.
senses.whyCN: 当「两个」成为表示「一小把」的常用说法后，这个词就扩展成指任意少数几个。

senses.title: To join two things together
senses.definition: to fasten or connect two things so they work together
senses.definitionCN: 把两个东西连接或搭配起来，使它们协同工作
senses.example: The teacher coupled each player with a younger partner.
senses.exampleCN: 老师把每个队员和一名低年级同学配对。
senses.why: Joining two into one pair is the action behind the noun, so the verb simply means to make a pair.
senses.whyCN: 把两个合成一对正是名词背后的动作，所以动词义就是「配成对」。

intro.en: Couple descends from a Latin word for a bond or tie.
intro.cn: couple 源自一个表示「束缚、联结」的拉丁词。

items.en: The Latin copula meant a bond or tie, from co- (together) + apere (to fasten).
items.cn: 拉丁语 copula 意为联结、纽带，由 co-（一起）+ apere（系紧）构成。

items.en: Old French made cople, meaning a pair joined together.
items.cn: 古法语形成 cople，指联结成对的一组。

items.en: English borrowed cople in the thirteenth century for two joined things.
items.cn: 英语在十三世纪借入 cople，指连在一起的两个东西。

items.en: It soon meant two people married or in love, and loosely a few.
items.cn: 它很快指结婚或相爱的两个人，也泛指少数几个。

items.en: The verb to couple keeps the original idea of fastening two together.
items.cn: 动词 to couple 保留了把两者系在一起的原始意思。

note.en: These words mean pairs or small numbers, or look alike.
note.cn: 这些词表示成对或少量，或与 couple 拼写相近。

entries.definition: two lines of poetry ending alike
twice as much; only spelled a bit alike
a ticket giving a discount; sounds alike, different root
entries.definitionCN: 优惠券（读音相近，词源不同）

entries.definition: a pair, especially of hunted birds

normalIntro.en: Use the pair idea and a couple of easy phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 用「成对」的概念和几个简单短语来记。

normal.en: couple = co + ple: pulled together into one pair.
normal.cn: couple = co（一起）+ ple（系）：被拉到一起成为一对。

normal.en: a couple of = two or a few, never a huge number.
normal.cn: a couple of ＝两个或几个，绝不是很大数目。

normal.en: Married couple is the most common phrase in daily talk.
normal.cn: married couple 是日常口语里最常见的说法。

normal.en: The verb couples things the way the noun pairs them.
normal.cn: 动词 couple 把东西配起来，正如名词把它们成对。

normal.en: Couplet keeps a tiny -et, meaning a small pair of lines.
normal.cn: couplet 带个小后缀 -et，指小小的一对诗行。

abstract.en: See two seats screwed side by side; that join is the core image.
abstract.cn: 想象两把椅子并排固定，那个连接就是核心意象。

abstract.en: Two hands clasped in a wedding photo: one couple, one unit.
abstract.cn: 婚礼照上交握的两只手：一对夫妇，一个整体。

abstract.en: Hold up two fingers, then relax the count; that is a couple of minutes.
abstract.cn: 竖起两根手指再把数放松些，这就是 a couple of minutes。

examples.en: The couple next door has two lovely cats.
examples.cn: 隔壁那对夫妇养了两只可爱的猫。

examples.en: Wait a couple of seconds before the light turns green.
examples.cn: 等个两三秒再等灯变绿。

examples.en: The trailer was coupled to the car in seconds.
examples.cn: 拖车几秒钟就连接到了汽车上。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「卡剖」——把两张卡「剖」成配好的一对

sensesIntro.en: From two joined people, to a few, to the act of joining.
sensesIntro.cn: 从成双的人，到少数几个，再到连接这个动作。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two things tied as one unit

latinIntro.en: The root idea is fastening or joining, shared with several Latin cousins.
latinIntro.cn: 词根核心是「系紧、连接」，与多个拉丁同族词共享。

items.example: a copula joins subject and rest
items.exampleCN: 系词连接主语与其余部分

definition_en: the ability to do something difficult or dangerous without fear
core_image: 明知会怕，仍然向前迈出的一步
scene: 轮到小林上台演讲了，他深吸一口气走上讲台。It takes courage to speak in front of the whole school.
sceneCN: 这里 courage 是「勇气」（第 1 个义项：面对害怕仍行动的力量）；句意是在全校面前演讲需要勇气。

derivatives.zh: 由 courage 加形容词后缀构成，义为「勇敢的；有胆量的」
由 en- 加 courage 构成，义为「鼓励；使有勇气」
encourage 的名词形式，义为「鼓励」
由 dis- 加 courage 构成，义为「使气馁；使泄气」

senses.title: Strength to face fear or danger
senses.titleCN: 面对恐惧或危险的力量
senses.definition: the quality that lets you act even when you are afraid
senses.definitionCN: 让你在害怕时仍然行动的品质
senses.example: The firefighter showed great courage by running into the fire.
senses.exampleCN: 消防员冲进火场，展现了极大的勇气。
senses.why: The core image is the heart as the seat of bravery, so courage is the strength your heart supplies.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是心是勇气的所在，所以 courage 就是心给出的力量。

senses.title: Strength to do something hard or painful
senses.titleCN: 做难事或忍受痛苦的胆量
senses.definition: the will to keep going through difficulty, pain or embarrassment
senses.definitionCN: 在困难、疼痛或尴尬面前坚持下去的意志
senses.example: It takes courage to admit a big mistake in front of everyone.
senses.exampleCN: 在大家面前承认大错需要勇气。
senses.why: Fear is not only about danger; hard truths also frighten, so the word covers them too.
senses.whyCN: 恐惧不只来自危险，难堪的真相同样吓人，所以这个词也覆盖这些情形。

intro.en: Courage comes straight from a Latin word for heart.
intro.cn: courage 直接来自一个表示「心」的拉丁词。

items.en: The Latin cor meant heart, the seat of feeling and will.
items.cn: 拉丁语 cor 意为心，被视为情感与意志的所在。

items.en: Coraticum, built on cor, meant matters of the heart, spirit.
items.cn: 建立在 cor 上的 coraticum 意为心事、精神状态。

items.en: Old French formed corage, meaning heart, inner spirit, boldness.
items.cn: 古法语形成 corage，意为心、内在精神、胆量。

items.en: English borrowed corage about the thirteenth century, first meaning the heart and its feelings.
items.cn: 英语约在十三世纪借入 corage，先指心及其情感。

items.en: Courage narrowed to mean bravery, the heart that holds firm.
items.cn: courage 词义收窄为「勇气」，即坚守的心。

note.en: These words share the heart root or name bravery.
note.cn: 这些词共享「心」的词根，或同样表示勇敢。

entries.definition: warm and friendly, from the heart
a small house; only spelled a bit alike
entries.definitionCN: 小屋（拼写略近，词源不同）

entries.definition: the courage to do something bold

normalIntro.en: The heart root and the encourage family make courage easy.
normalIntro.cn: 「心」的词根加上 encourage 词族让 courage 好记。

normal.en: courage = cor + age: the heart's age-tested strength.
normal.cn: courage = cor（心）+ age：心经过考验的力量。

normal.en: en- + courage = put courage in: encourage.
normal.cn: en- + courage ＝把勇气放进去：encourage（鼓励）。

normal.en: dis- + courage = take courage out: discourage.
normal.cn: dis- + courage ＝把勇气抽走：discourage（使气馁）。

normal.en: cordial is the same heart root meaning warm.
normal.cn: cordial 同源，意为热忱的。

normal.en: The adjective swaps -age for -ageous: courageous.
normal.cn: 形容词把 -age 变成 -ageous：courageous。

abstract.en: Feel your heart pound before the race; courage is stepping up anyway.
abstract.cn: 感受赛前十秒砰砰的心跳；courage 就是照样迈上起跑线。

abstract.en: Picture a small lantern held high in the dark; the light is your heart.
abstract.cn: 想象黑暗中高举的小灯笼，那光就是你的心。

abstract.en: Raising your hand to ask a question takes courage too.
abstract.cn: 举手提问同样需要勇气。

examples.en: She had the courage to tell the teacher the truth.
examples.cn: 她有勇气把真相告诉老师。

examples.en: Climbing that rock wall called for real courage.
examples.cn: 爬那面攀岩墙需要真正的勇气。

examples.en: His kind words encouraged the whole team.
examples.cn: 他暖心的话语鼓励了全队。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「卡瑞之」——心里装着「卡不倒的瑞气」，就有了勇气

root: 来自拉丁语 cor（心）派生的 coraticum，经古法语 corage 进入英语；本义「心、内在精神」，后专指「勇气」；encourage、discourage、cordial 同源。

sensesIntro.en: From facing danger to facing hard truths, courage is the firm heart.
sensesIntro.cn: 从直面危险到直面难堪，courage 就是那颗坚定的心。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a steady heart in a shaking moment
core.cn: 核心意象：动摇时刻里那颗坚定的心

branches.cn: 日常的勇气，不只属于英雄

intro.en: Courage and its family all point back to one Latin word for heart.
intro.cn: courage 及其词族都指向一个表示「心」的拉丁词。

latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词根 cor 意为心，是情感的所在。

definition_en: a series of lessons; the way something moves or develops over time; one part of a meal
core_image: 一条从起点流向终点的路
scene: 新学期第一节数学课前，老师把课本发给了大家。Our maths course will last the whole term.
sceneCN: 这里 course 是「课程」（第 1 个义项：一连串有安排的课）；句意是我们的数学课将持续整个学期。

derivatives.zh: 由 court 加 yard 构成，义为「庭院」
同根名词，义为「球场；法庭；宫廷」
由 dis- 加 course 构成，义为「谈话；论述」

senses.title: A series of lessons on a subject
senses.definition: a planned set of lessons or studies on one subject
senses.definitionCN: 围绕一个科目的有计划的课程或学习安排
senses.example: She signed up for a summer swimming course.
senses.exampleCN: 她报名参加了暑期游泳课程。
senses.why: The core image is a path from start to finish, and a course of study is exactly that path walked through lessons.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是起点到终点的路径，而课程正是用一节节课走完的学习之路。

senses.title: The way something develops over time
senses.definition: the natural movement or development of something
senses.definitionCN: 事物自然的运动或发展过程
senses.example: The disease ran its course, and he soon got better.
senses.exampleCN: 病程自然走完，他很快好转了。
senses.why: Because the word first meant running or flowing onward, it fits anything that moves forward over time.
senses.whyCN: 因为这个词最初指奔跑或流动向前，所以适合描述随时间推进的过程。

senses.title: A path or line of movement
senses.definition: the direction or line along which something moves
senses.definitionCN: 物体移动所沿的方向或路线
senses.example: The ship changed course to avoid the storm.
senses.exampleCN: 船改变航线以避开风暴。
senses.why: A runner follows a course across a field; a ship follows one across the sea, so the route sense keeps the image.
senses.whyCN: 跑步者沿路径穿过田野，船沿航线穿越大海，所以路线义保留了这一意象。

senses.title: One part of a meal served in order
senses.definition: one of the parts of a meal, served one after another
senses.definitionCN: 按顺序端上的一餐中的一部分
senses.example: For the main course we had fish and rice.
senses.exampleCN: 主菜我们吃了鱼和米饭。
senses.why: Dishes arrive one after another along the meal's path, so each stage is a course.
senses.whyCN: 菜肴沿着这顿饭的路径一道道端上来，所以每一道都叫 a course。

intro.en: Course goes back to a Latin verb that meant to run.
intro.cn: course 可追溯到拉丁语中意为「跑」的动词。

items.en: The Latin verb currere meant to run, giving the noun cursus, a running or course.
items.cn: 拉丁语动词 currere 意为奔跑，派生名词 cursus，指奔跑、行程。

items.en: Old French carried it over as cors, meaning a running or an onward path.
items.cn: 古法语将其变为 cors，意为奔跑、前行的路径。

items.en: English borrowed cours in the thirteenth century for onward movement.
items.cn: 英语在十三世纪借入 cours，指向前的运动。

items.en: Its senses widened to a path of travel, a way of life and a planned study.
items.cn: 词义扩展为行进路线、生活方式和有计划的学习。

items.en: Today course covers lessons, routes, processes and meal stages.
items.cn: 如今 course 覆盖课程、路线、过程和菜式。

note.en: These words share the running root or name paths and lessons.
note.cn: 这些词共享「奔跑」词根，或指路线与课程。

normalIntro.en: The running root and everyday phrases keep course in place.
normalIntro.cn: 「奔跑」词根和日常短语让 course 牢记于心。

normal.en: curs- means run: current, cursor and course all run.
normal.cn: 词根 curs- 意为跑：current、cursor、course 都在跑。

normal.en: of course: things run as expected, so it means surely.
normal.cn: of course：事情照常运转，所以意为当然。

normal.en: A swimming course runs from first lesson to last.
normal.cn: 游泳课程从第一节课跑到最后一节课。

normal.en: Main course arrives after the starter in a meal's run.
normal.cn: 主菜在一餐的进程中介于开胃菜之后。

normal.en: Discourse adds dis-, meaning talk that runs back and forth.
normal.cn: discourse 加 dis-，指来回交流的谈话。

abstract.en: Picture a runner with a flag moving from start line to finish line.
abstract.cn: 想象一名举着小旗的跑者从起点线奔向终点线。

abstract.en: See a ship's dotted line on the sea map bending to a new direction.
abstract.cn: 看海图上船的虚线弯向新方向。

abstract.en: Plates arrive one by one down the middle of the table; each is a course.
abstract.cn: 盘子沿桌中央一道道端上来，每盘就是一道菜。

examples.en: The new English course begins next Monday.
examples.cn: 新英语课程下周一开始。

examples.en: Of course I will help you with your homework.
examples.cn: 我当然会帮你做作业。

examples.en: Our plane changed course because of the wind.
examples.cn: 因为风，我们的飞机改变了航向。

sensesIntro.en: From a running path come lessons, processes, routes and dishes.
sensesIntro.cn: 从一条奔跑的路径，长出了课程、过程、航线和菜道。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a path that runs from start to end
core.cn: 核心意象：一条从起点跑到终点的路径

branches.en: Planned lessons from start to finish

definition_en: a child of your uncle or aunt; a person related to you in a similar way
core_image: 同一位祖父母下的另一家的孩子
scene: 春节全家团聚，表妹抱着新买的娃娃跑进院子。My cousin is coming to stay with us during the holiday.
sceneCN: 这里 cousin 是「表兄弟姐妹」（第 1 个义项：叔叔阿姨家的孩子）；句意是假期里我的表妹要来和我们同住。

derivatives.zh: 由 cousin 加形容词后缀构成，义为「像堂（表）亲般的」
关系词，义为「叔叔；舅舅」
关系词，义为「姑姑；姨母」

senses.title: A child of your uncle or aunt
senses.definition: the son or daughter of your aunt or uncle
senses.definitionCN: 你叔叔、舅舅或姑姑、姨母的儿子或女儿
senses.example: Ten cousins gathered at grandma's house for the New Year dinner.
senses.exampleCN: 十个表兄弟姐妹在奶奶家团聚吃年夜饭。
senses.why: The core image is two family lines meeting at one grandparent, so the children of both lines are cousins.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是两条家庭支线在同一祖父母处汇合，所以两条支线的孩子互为堂表亲。

senses.title: Something similar to another in its group
senses.definition: a thing that is related to or like another thing in the same family or group
senses.definitionCN: 同一族类或同一组里与另一物相似的东西
senses.example: The koala is a distant cousin of the kangaroo in the marsupial family.
senses.exampleCN: 在有袋类家族里，考拉是袋鼠的远亲。
senses.why: When two things share one ancestor or one job, speakers borrow the family word cousin for them.
senses.whyCN: 当两样东西共有一个祖先或共同职能时，人们借用家庭词汇 cousin 来称呼它们。

intro.en: Cousin comes from Latin through French, built on a word for blood relationship.
intro.cn: cousin 经法语来自拉丁语，建立在表示血缘关系的词之上。

items.en: The Latin consobrinus meant a child of a mother's sister, a blood relative.
items.cn: 拉丁语 consobrinus 指姨母的孩子，即血亲。

items.en: Old French changed it to cosin, meaning any relative, not only the mother's side.
items.cn: 古法语将其变为 cosin，泛指亲戚，不再限于母系。

items.en: English borrowed cosin in the thirteenth century, at first for almost any kinsman.
items.cn: 英语在十三世纪借入 cosin，起初几乎泛指任何亲属。

items.en: Later it narrowed to mean children of uncles and aunts.
items.cn: 后来词义收窄为叔叔阿姨家的孩子。

items.en: Today cousin also names things that are alike in a family of ideas.
items.cn: 如今 cousin 也指概念家族中相似的事物。

note.en: These words name family members or look close to cousin.
note.cn: 这些词指家庭成员，或与 cousin 拼写读音相近。

normalIntro.en: Use the family tree and the shared letters to remember cousin.
normalIntro.cn: 用家谱和共同字母记牢 cousin。

normal.en: cousin sounds like coz: someone close and cozy in the family.
normal.cn: cousin 读音像 coz：家里亲近 cozy 的人。

normal.en: A cousin lives at the same branch of the family tree.
normal.cn: cousin 就住在家谱的同一枝上。

normal.en: Nouns in -in like cousin often came through French.
normal.cn: 像 cousin 这样以 -in 结尾的名词常经法语而来。

normal.en: First cousin = your uncle's or aunt's child, the closest cousin.
normal.cn: first cousin ＝叔叔阿姨的孩子，最亲的堂表亲。

normal.en: Animals can be cousins too when species share ancestors.
normal.cn: 物种共享祖先时，动物也可以是「远亲」。

abstract.en: Picture two small houses joined by one path to grandma's door.
abstract.cn: 想象两座小房子由一条小路通向奶奶家门口。

abstract.en: See two kids sharing one swing; they are cousins at the family party.
abstract.cn: 看两个孩子共用一个秋千，他们是家庭聚会上的表兄妹。

abstract.en: Draw a simple tree: trunk for grandparents, two branches for cousins.
abstract.cn: 画一棵简单的树：树干是祖父母，两根树枝是堂表亲。

examples.en: My cousin from Chengdu sent me a birthday card.
examples.cn: 我在成都的表哥给我寄了一张生日贺卡。

examples.en: All the cousins played badminton in the yard.
examples.cn: 堂表兄弟姐妹们都在院子里打羽毛球。

examples.en: The seal is a cousin of the sea lion.
examples.cn: 海豹是海狮的近亲。

sensesIntro.en: From shared grandparents to shared ancestors of any kind.
sensesIntro.cn: 从共享祖父母，到共享任何祖先。

branches.cn: 概念家族中的相似事物

latinIntro.en: The root sobrinus described a mother's-sister relationship.
latinIntro.cn: 词根 sobrinus 描述姨表关系。

definition_en: to put something over or on top; to include or deal with a range of things
core_image: 一块布或一个盖子压在上面的画面
scene: 要下雨了，妈妈快步走到阳台，把晾着的被子搬了进来。Please cover the fish bowl before the cat arrives.
sceneCN: 这里 cover 是「盖住」（第 1 个义项：把东西放在上面遮住）；句意是猫来之前请把鱼缸盖上。

derivatives.zh: 由动词加 -age 构成，义为「覆盖范围；新闻报道量」

由动词加 -ing 构成，义为「覆盖物」

senses.title: To put something over the top
senses.definition: to place something over or in front of another thing so it is hidden or protected
senses.definitionCN: 把某物放在另一物的上面或前面，使其被遮住或受到保护
senses.example: Cover the leftovers before you put them in the fridge.
senses.exampleCN: 把剩菜盖好再放进冰箱。
senses.why: The core image is a lid or cloth pressed down over a thing, so any act of shielding from above is cover.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是盖子或布压在东西上方，所以一切自上而下的遮盖都可以叫 cover。

senses.title: To include a range of topics or areas
senses.definition: to deal with or contain many things within one range
senses.definitionCN: 在一个范围内处理或包含多种事物
senses.example: This chapter covers how plants make food.
senses.exampleCN: 这一章讲的是植物如何制造养分。
senses.why: A big cloth lies across the whole table; in the same way, one word or lesson may lie across many topics.
senses.whyCN: 一块大布铺满整张桌子；同样，一个词或一节课也能铺满许多话题。

senses.title: To protect or hide for someone
senses.definition: to protect a person or keep them from being seen or blamed
senses.definitionCN: 保护某人，或使其不被发现、不被责怪
senses.example: Our keeper moved quickly to cover the goal.
senses.exampleCN: 守门员迅速移动去封堵球门。
senses.why: Sheltering under cover keeps a soldier safe, so helping someone by standing between them and danger is also covering.
senses.whyCN: 躲在掩体下能让士兵安全，所以站到别人与危险之间保护他们也是 covering。

senses.title: To report an event as a journalist
senses.definition: to follow and report news about an event
senses.definitionCN: 对某事件进行跟踪报道
senses.example: Two school reporters covered the sports meeting.
senses.exampleCN: 两名校园记者报道了运动会。
senses.why: News spreads over the whole surface of an event like a sheet laid over it, so journalists cover events.
senses.whyCN: 新闻像铺在事件上的一层布覆盖全局，所以记者们「覆盖」事件。

intro.en: Cover traces back to Latin words about catching and covering over.
intro.cn: cover 可追溯到拉丁语中与「捕获、覆罩」相关的词。

items.en: The Latin co-operire meant to cover completely, with co- (together) plus operire (to cover).
items.cn: 拉丁语 co-operire 意为完全盖住，由 co-（一起）加 operire（覆盖）构成。

items.en: A related word capere, to seize, is thought by some scholars to be mixed in; the exact link is debated.
items.cn: 一些学者认为相关词 capere（抓住）也掺入其中；具体联系尚有争议。

items.en: Old French formed covrir, meaning to cover or protect.
items.cn: 古法语形成 covrir，意为覆盖、保护。

items.en: English borrowed coveren in the thirteenth century, meaning to cover over.
items.cn: 英语在十三世纪借入 coveren，意为盖上。

items.en: The noun cover for book covers and lids appeared later, and the verb spread to news and ranges.
items.cn: 名词 cover 指书皮和盖子出现较晚，动词义扩展到新闻和范围。

note.en: These words share the cover root or name things that hide or lie on top.
note.cn: 这些词与 cover 同根，或指遮盖、覆在上面的东西。

entries.definition: how much an event is reported or a plan protects
to find something hidden, un-cover it
to get back to health or get something back
a thick cover for a bed; as a verb, to lie all over
to fold paper or cloth around
to wrap completely; also a paper holder

normalIntro.en: The cover family and daily covers make the word stick.
normalIntro.cn: cover 词族和身边的「盖」让这个词扎根。

normal.en: co- + operire: cover fully, so cover means put over.
normal.cn: co- 加 operire：完全盖上，所以 cover 意为盖上。

normal.en: dis-cover: take the cover away, so discover means find.
normal.cn: dis-cover：把盖子拿走，所以 discover 意为发现。

normal.en: re-cover: cover again, so recover means get back.
normal.cn: re-cover：再盖回来，所以 recover 意为恢复、找回。

normal.en: Be covered with snow: the passive shows what lies on top.
normal.cn: be covered with snow：被动式说明上面盖着什么。

normal.en: The front cover of a notebook is the lid of the pages.
normal.cn: 笔记本的封面就是书页的盖子。

abstract.en: Watch a tablecloth slide across the table until no wood shows.
abstract.cn: 看桌布滑过桌面，直到一点木头都不露。

abstract.en: Snow falls all night; in the morning the field is one white cover.
abstract.cn: 雪下了一夜，清晨的田野变成一整块白色的盖子。

abstract.en: One quiz question may cover three chapters at once.
abstract.cn: 一道测验题可能同时覆盖三章内容。

examples.en: The ground was covered with yellow leaves after the storm.
examples.cn: 暴风雨过后，地面铺满了黄叶。

examples.en: Our report covers the school sports meeting.
examples.cn: 我们的报告报道了校运动会。

examples.en: Mom asked me to cover the pot so the soup stays warm.
examples.cn: 妈妈让我把锅盖上，让汤保持温热。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「卡我」——一张大卡「卡」住我，把我盖住了

root: 来自拉丁语 co-operire（完全覆盖，co-「一起」+ operire「盖上」），经古法语 covrir 进入英语；与 discover、recover 等构成「盖上—揭开—复原」的词族。

sensesIntro.en: From a lid over a pot, to topics under one range, to news over an event.
sensesIntro.cn: 从锅盖，到一个范围下的多个话题，再到铺满事件的新闻。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a lid pressed down over something
core.cn: 核心意象：一个盖子压在东西上面

branches.en: Cloths, lids and snow on top
branches.cn: 布、盖子和积雪覆在上面

branches.en: Standing between a friend and harm
Cover as shelter, not concealment only
branches.cn: cover 作为掩体，不只是藏匿

intro.en: Cover sits at the middle of a family of pre-verbed cousins.
intro.cn: cover 位于一组加前缀动词词族的中间。

latinIntro.en: The Latin root operire means to cover over.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词根 operire 意为盖上、覆住。

definition_en: a large female farm animal kept for milk; the female of some large animals
core_image: 草场上缓缓吃草的黑白大块头
scene: 暑假去乡下姥姥家，清晨的草场上奶牛正在吃草。The cows give fresh milk every morning.
sceneCN: 这里 cow 是「奶牛」（第 1 个义项：产奶的母牛）；句意是奶牛每天早晨产出新鲜的牛奶。

derivatives.zh: 同族词，泛指「牛；牲畜」
由 cow 加 boy 构成，义为「牛仔」

senses.title: A female farm animal kept for milk
senses.definition: a big female animal on farms that gives milk after having a calf
senses.definitionCN: 农场里生过小牛后产奶的大型雌性动物
senses.example: The farmer milked the cows at dawn and carried the pails home.
senses.exampleCN: 农夫黎明时分挤奶，把奶桶提回了家。
senses.why: The core image is the gentle giant of the farm that feeds people with milk, so the milk animal is the everyday cow.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是农场里用牛奶喂养人们的温柔巨兽，所以产奶的动物就是日常说的 cow。

senses.title: The female of other large animals
senses.definition: the female of animals such as whales, elephants and seals
senses.definitionCN: 鲸、象、海豹等大型动物的雌性
senses.example: A cow whale swam beside her calf near the bay.
senses.exampleCN: 海湾边，一头母鲸带着幼鲸游过。
senses.why: Farmers named animal mothers after their most familiar one, so female whales and elephants borrow the word cow.
senses.whyCN: 农夫用最熟悉的动物母亲来称呼其他动物母亲，所以母鲸母象也借用了 cow。

senses.title: To frighten someone into obedience
senses.definition: to make someone too frightened to refuse or complain
senses.definitionCN: 把某人吓得不敢拒绝或抱怨
senses.example: The loud teacher cowed the new pupils into silence.
senses.exampleCN: 嗓门大的老师吓得新学生们不敢作声。
senses.why: A shout can press a person down like a weight, so the word also means to crush courage.
senses.whyCN: 一声吼叫能像重物一样把人压下去，所以这个词也有压垮勇气的意思。

intro.en: Cow is one of the oldest words in English, from ancient farm life.
intro.cn: cow 是英语里最古老的词之一，来自远古的农耕生活。

items.en: The Old English cu came from a Germanic root kwon, shared with German Kuh.
items.cn: 古英语 cu 来自日耳曼语词根 kwon，与德语 Kuh 同源。

items.en: The root is thought to imitate lowing sounds, though this is a common guess.
items.cn: 一般认为该词根模仿牛的哞叫，不过这只是常见推测。

items.en: In Old English, cu named the milk animal of the village field.
items.cn: 在古英语中，cu 指村里田野上的产奶动物。

items.en: The plural kine was used in books, while cows took over in speech.
items.cn: 书面语用复数 kine，口语则由 cows 取代。

items.en: Cow spread to female whales and elephants, and later to the verb sense of frightening.
items.cn: cow 扩展到母鲸母象，后来又有了「吓住」的动词义。

note.en: These words name farm animals or look close to cow.
note.cn: 这些词指农场动物，或与 cow 拼写读音相近。

entries.definition: a person who fears too much; only the tail letters match, different root
entries.definitionCN: 胆小鬼（词尾相近，词源不同）

entries.definition: a worker who rides after cattle
bulls and cows as a group
a black bird; only spelled a bit alike
entries.definitionCN: 乌鸦（拼写略近，词源不同）

entries.definition: a young female cow before its first calf

normalIntro.en: Farm sounds and the cow family help fix this old word.
normalIntro.cn: 农场的声音和 cow 词族帮你记住这个古老的词。

normal.en: cow sounds like a low ka-wu moo you hear on a farm.
normal.cn: cow 的读音像「咖乌」，像农场里牛的叫声。

normal.en: cow + boy = cowboy, the rider who minds cows.
normal.cn: cow + boy ＝ cowboy，看管牛群的骑手。

normal.en: Bull is the male, cow the female, calf the baby.
normal.cn: bull 是公牛，cow 是母牛，calf 是小牛。

normal.en: A herd of cows walks slowly to the shed each evening.
normal.cn: 一群牛每天傍晚慢慢走回牛棚。

normal.en: Be cowed means being shouted down, not turned into a cow.
normal.cn: be cowed 是被吓住，不是变成一头牛。

abstract.en: See black and white patches moving across a green field like puzzle pieces.
abstract.cn: 看黑白斑块像拼图块一样在绿场上移动。

abstract.en: Hear the pail clang at dawn; that sound belongs to cows.
abstract.cn: 听黎明时分奶桶的哐当声，那声音属于奶牛。

abstract.en: Feel the calm of chewing: cows spend hours chewing grass.
abstract.cn: 感受咀嚼的平静：奶牛要花几个小时嚼草。

examples.en: The cows walked home along the small river.
examples.cn: 奶牛们沿着小河走回家。

examples.en: Fresh milk from the farm cow tastes different from shop milk.
examples.cn: 农场奶牛的新鲜牛奶和商店牛奶味道不同。

examples.en: A cow elephant led her calf across the plain.
examples.cn: 一头母象带着幼象走过平原。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「靠」——奶牛靠在栅栏边慢慢吃草

root: 来自古英语 cu，与德语 Kuh 同源于日耳曼语词根 kwon；有观点认为它模仿牛叫声，尚属推测；是英语最古老的动物词之一。

sensesIntro.en: From the milk animal of the farm, to mothers of the wild, to a shout that presses courage down.
sensesIntro.cn: 从农场的产奶动物，到野外的兽母，再到压下勇气的一声吼。

core.cn: 核心意象：产奶的缓慢温柔巨兽

Courage pressed down by a shout

intro.cn: cow 本身是单纯的词根，却能长出许多复合词。

definition_en: very strange or not sensible; extremely enthusiastic about something
core_image: 头发乱翘、想法乱飞的怪人
scene: 愚人节那天，同桌竟然把橡皮擦当成了面包咬了一口，全班笑翻。That was a really crazy thing to do.
sceneCN: 这里 crazy 是「疯狂的」（第 1 个义项：不像正常人会做的傻事）；句意是那实在是一件疯狂的事。

derivatives.zh: 由词根 craze 构成，义为「狂热；时尚风潮」
由 crazy 加副词后缀构成，义为「疯狂地」
由 crazy 加名词后缀构成，义为「疯狂；愚蠢」

senses.title: Not sensible; very strange
senses.definition: silly or unreasonable in a way that surprises people
senses.definitionCN: 愚蠢或不合常理，让人吃惊
senses.example: It was crazy to swim in the river in December.
senses.exampleCN: 十二月在河里游泳太疯狂了。
senses.why: The core image is a mind that has slipped its tracks, so acts no sane person would choose are crazy.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是头脑脱了轨，所以正常人不会选的行为就是 crazy。

senses.title: Extremely fond of something
senses.definition: liking something so much that it seems to fill your whole mind
senses.definitionCN: 喜欢某物到了它占满整个脑袋的程度
senses.example: Ben is crazy about space movies and watches one every weekend.
senses.exampleCN: 本对太空电影着迷，每个周末都要看一部。
senses.why: The same slipped-track mind now runs only toward one thing, so deep love for a hobby is also crazy.
senses.whyCN: 同样脱轨的头脑现在只朝一个方向跑，所以对爱好的痴迷也可以用 crazy。

senses.title: Wild or out of control
senses.definition: moving, noisy or changing in a wild, uncontrolled way
senses.definitionCN: 以狂乱、失控的方式移动、喧闹或变化
senses.example: The last day before the holiday was crazy at school.
senses.exampleCN: 放假前的最后一天，学校里乱成一团。
senses.why: When many things fly at once, the scene looks like the slipped mind made real, so chaos is crazy too.
senses.whyCN: 当许多事情同时乱飞时，场面就像脱轨头脑的现实版，所以混乱也是 crazy。

intro.en: Crazy grew from an old word that meant to shatter or crack.
intro.cn: crazy 由一个意为「打碎、破裂」的旧词发展而来。

items.en: The Old Norse krasa meant to smash or break, the likely source of the crack idea.
items.cn: 古诺斯语 krasa 意为砸碎、打破，很可能是「破裂」意象的来源。

items.en: English had the verb craze, meaning to shatter or make cracks in pottery.
items.cn: 英语动词 craze 意为打碎，或让陶器产生裂纹。

items.en: Later craze shifted from cracked pots to damaged minds.
items.cn: 后来 craze 从「开裂的陶器」转向「受损的心智」。

items.en: The adjective crazy first meant cracked or frail, then mad.
items.cn: 形容词 crazy 先指开裂易碎的，后指发疯的。

items.en: Today crazy covers silly acts, strong likings and wild scenes.
items.cn: 如今 crazy 覆盖傻事、痴迷和狂乱场面。

note.en: These words share the crack idea or name wild states.
note.cn: 这些词共享「破裂」意象，或表示狂乱状态。

entries.definition: not wanting to work; only the ending matches
entries.definitionCN: 懒惰的（词尾相近，词源不同）

entries.definition: a small flower; sounds similar, different root
entries.definitionCN: 雏菊（读音相近，词源不同）

unable to stop thinking about something

normalIntro.en: The crack idea and daily phrases hold crazy in memory.
normalIntro.cn: 「破裂」意象和日常短语把 crazy 挂在记忆里。

normal.en: craze = crack: a cracked mind or cracked pot.
normal.cn: craze ＝ crack：开裂的心智或开裂的陶罐。

normal.en: go crazy: the mind snaps, so you lose calm.
normal.cn: go crazy：脑子崩了，所以失去冷静。

normal.en: crazy about basketball: your whole mind runs to the ball.
normal.cn: crazy about basketball：整个脑袋都朝篮球跑。

normal.en: drive someone crazy: push them until they crack.
normal.cn: drive someone crazy：把人逼到开裂。

normal.en: like crazy: work as if your mind has snapped into speed.
normal.cn: like crazy：像脑子崩进了加速档一样拼命。

abstract.en: Hear a tiny crack run across a plate; that crack can grow into wildness.
abstract.cn: 听瓷器上一道细小的裂纹蔓延，那道裂纹可以长成狂乱。

abstract.en: See hair standing in ten directions and ideas flying after it.
abstract.cn: 看头发朝十个方向立起，念头跟着四处乱飞。

abstract.en: Feel the last-minute rush before the bell: papers, shouts, laughter all at once.
abstract.cn: 感受铃响前的最后冲刺：试卷、喊声、笑声一齐炸开。

examples.en: Wearing shorts in the snow is a crazy idea.
examples.cn: 下雪天穿短裤是个疯狂的主意。

examples.en: The fans went crazy when their team scored.
examples.cn: 球队进球时球迷们疯狂欢呼。

examples.en: My little brother is crazy about dinosaurs.
examples.cn: 我弟弟对恐龙着迷极了。

sensesIntro.en: A crack in a pot becomes a crack in the mind, then wildness everywhere.
sensesIntro.cn: 陶罐上的裂缝变成头脑里的裂缝，再蔓延成四处狂乱。

definition_en: the thick fatty part of milk; a soft skin lotion; a pale yellowish-white colour
core_image: 浮在鲜奶最上层的那层厚厚的白
scene: 生日蛋糕端上来，最上面一层白色的奶油闪闪发亮。Strawberry cake with cream is my birthday favourite.
sceneCN: 这里 cream 是「奶油」（第 1 个义项：牛奶中厚厚的脂肪层）；句意是配奶油的草莓蛋糕是我的生日最爱。

derivatives.zh: 由 cream 加形容词后缀构成，义为「奶油般的；含奶油的」
由 cream 加场所后缀构成，义为「奶油厂；乳品店」
复合词，义为「冰淇淋」

senses.title: The thick fatty part of milk
senses.definition: the thick, pale-yellow fatty layer that rises to the top of milk
senses.definitionCN: 浮到牛奶顶部的淡黄色厚脂肪层
senses.example: Mom poured cold cream over the fresh strawberries.
senses.exampleCN: 妈妈把凉奶油浇在新摘的草莓上。
senses.why: The core image is the richest layer sitting on top of milk, so cream is the heavy white part that floats up.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是最浓的那层浮在牛奶上，所以 cream 就是那层上浮的厚白脂肪。

senses.title: A smooth skin lotion
senses.definition: a smooth substance rubbed on the skin to protect or clean it
senses.definitionCN: 涂在皮肤上保护或清洁的光滑膏体
senses.example: This winter hand cream stops my skin from cracking.
senses.exampleCN: 这种冬季护手霜防止我的皮肤开裂。
senses.why: Thick white cream from milk and thick white lotion for skin look and feel alike, so the name moved across.
senses.whyCN: 牛奶里的厚白奶油和护肤的厚白膏体看起来手感都相似，所以名称迁移了过去。

senses.title: A pale yellowish-white colour
senses.definition: a very pale yellowish-white colour like fresh cream
senses.definitionCN: 像新鲜奶油一样的浅黄白色
senses.example: She painted her bedroom walls a soft cream colour.
senses.exampleCN: 她把卧室墙刷成了柔和的奶油色。
senses.why: Once the dairy word was fixed, its colour became a colour name, like orange and rose.
senses.whyCN: 乳品义固定后，它的颜色也成了颜色名，就像 orange 和 rose。

senses.title: The best part of a group
senses.definition: the best people or things in a group
senses.definitionCN: 一群人里最优秀的那部分
senses.example: The three winners were the cream of this year's contest.

senses.title: To set up an organisation or system

items.en: The verb widened to artists, builders and founders.

items.en: Today create covers art, jobs, systems and problems alike.

senses.title: Good at thinking of new ideas

senses.example: Creative pupils solved the puzzle in three different ways.

senses.title: A person who breaks the law
senses.definition: someone who has done something the law punishes
senses.definitionCN: 做了法律要惩罚之事的人
senses.example: Two criminals tried to hide in an old warehouse.
senses.exampleCN: 两名罪犯试图躲进一座旧仓库。
senses.why: The core image is a person carrying the charge named in court, so the doer inherits the crime's name.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是背负法庭罪名的那个人，所以行为者继承了罪行的名字。

senses.title: Connected with crime and punishment
senses.definition: relating to laws about punishable acts
senses.definitionCN: 与可惩罚行为的法律有关的
senses.example: Criminal cases are heard in a different court from family cases.
senses.exampleCN: 刑事案件在不同于家事案件的法庭审理。
senses.why: Once the word names the person, it also names the whole field of law around him.
senses.whyCN: 这个词既指人，也延伸指围绕他的整个法律领域。

senses.title: Shamefully wrong
senses.titleCN: 可耻的；极不应该的（比喻）
senses.definition: very wrong or unfair, though not against the law
senses.definitionCN: 非常错误或不公平，虽不违法
senses.example: It would be criminal to waste this once-in-a-lifetime chance.
senses.exampleCN: 浪费这次千载难逢的机会实在可惜。
senses.why: The court line again becomes a moral line, so unfair acts wear the same word.
senses.whyCN: 法庭的线再次变成道德的线，所以不公之事也穿上这个词。

intro.en: Criminal follows crime straight out of Latin judgement language.
intro.cn: criminal 顺着 crime 一路源自拉丁语的裁断用语。

items.en: The Latin crimen meant a charge or judgement point.
items.cn: 拉丁语 crimen 意为指控或裁断要点。

items.en: The adjective criminalis described matters brought before a court.
items.cn: 拉丁语形容词 criminalis 描述提交法庭的事项。

items.en: Old French carried criminel into its law vocabulary.
items.cn: 古法语将 criminel 带入法律词汇。

items.en: English borrowed criminel in the fourteenth century, at first as a law adjective.
items.cn: 英语在十四世纪借入 criminel，起初是法律形容词。

items.en: The noun use for lawbreakers became the common everyday sense.
items.cn: 指违法者的名词用法成为日常常见义。

note.en: These words belong to the crime family or name law and guilt.
note.cn: 这些词属于 crime 词族，或指法律与罪责。

entries.definition: in a way punished by law
one who breaks a rule or law

normalIntro.en: Follow crime into its person form and its law form.
normalIntro.cn: 顺着 crime 看它的人形与法律形态。

normal.en: crime + inal = criminal, of crime or the person of crime.
normal.cn: crime + inal ＝ criminal，犯罪相关的或犯罪的人。

normal.en: Criminal law punishes; civil law settles debts.
normal.cn: 刑法惩罚，民法了结纠纷。

normal.en: A criminal record follows a person for years.
normal.cn: 犯罪记录会跟随人很多年。

normal.en: Catch the criminal: the police verb phrase.
normal.cn: catch the criminal：警方固定说法。

normal.en: Criminal waste means shamefully big waste.
normal.cn: criminal waste 指可耻的巨大浪费。

abstract.en: See handcuffs closing on a pair of hands at the park gate.
abstract.cn: 看公园门口一副手铐合拢在一双手上。

abstract.en: Hear the judge's list of charges being read out.
abstract.cn: 听法官逐条宣读罪名。

abstract.en: Feel anger at a broken promise to a whole team.
abstract.cn: 感受对一个团队失信的愤怒，那也是一种「罪」。

examples.en: The young criminal returned the stolen bike and said sorry.
examples.cn: 年轻的罪犯归还了偷来的自行车并道歉。

examples.en: Detectives studied the map for weeks to find the criminal.
examples.cn: 侦探们研究地图数周以找到罪犯。

examples.en: Throwing away school books is a criminal waste.
examples.cn: 扔掉课本是一种可耻的浪费。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「克瑞米诺」——罪名「克」住他，「诺」言也救不了

root: 来自拉丁语 criminalis（提交法庭的），建立在 crimen（罪名）之上，经古法语 criminel 进入英语；既指「罪犯」，也指「刑事的」。

sensesIntro.en: From the person who crossed the line, to the law around it, to moral blame.
sensesIntro.cn: 从越线之人，到相关法律，再到道德指责。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a name written next to a charge
core.cn: 核心意象：写在罪名旁边的名字

branches.en: The person caught for the act

branches.cn: 被称作 criminal 的浪费与不公

intro.en: Criminal wears a Latin adjective suffix on the crime root.
intro.cn: criminal 在 crime 词根上戴着拉丁形容词后缀。

latinIntro.en: The Latin root crimen means charge or judgement.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词根 crimen 意为指控、裁断。

definition_zh: 脆的；酥脆的；清爽的； crisp 的动词义为使发脆
definition_en: firm and dry so it makes a clean breaking sound; fresh and pleasantly cold
core_image: 咬下去咔嚓一声的清爽脆响
scene: 秋游野餐时，打开一包新买的薯片，咔嚓声让全组同学都笑了。The chips stay crisp inside the sealed bag.
sceneCN: 这里 crisp 是「脆的」（第 1 个义项：咬起来干脆有声）；句意是薯片在密封袋里保持酥脆。

derivatives.zh: 由 crisp 加副词后缀构成，义为「干脆利落地」
由 crisp 加名词后缀构成，义为「酥脆；清爽」
同义变体，义为「酥脆的」

senses.title: Firm and making a clean break
senses.definition: hard, dry and fresh so it breaks with a pleasant sound
senses.definitionCN: 又硬又干又新鲜，咬断时发出悦耳的脆响
senses.example: The winter apples are crisp and sweet.
senses.exampleCN: 冬天的苹果脆甜可口。
senses.why: The core image is a clean snap when you bite, so dry firmness that snaps is crisp.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是咬下时干脆的一声断响，所以能咔嚓一声断开的干硬就是 crisp。

senses.title: Fresh and pleasantly cold
senses.definition: air or weather that is cold, dry and refreshing
senses.definitionCN: 凉爽干燥、令人神清气爽的空气或天气
senses.example: We enjoyed the crisp air on the morning walk.
senses.exampleCN: 晨走时我们享受着清爽的空气。
senses.why: A clean snap in the mouth feels sharp and fresh; the same freshness rides on cold air.
senses.whyCN: 口中的干脆感是清冽新鲜的；同样的新鲜感也附着在冷空气中。

senses.title: Short, clear and quick
senses.definition: said or done in a quick, clear way without extra words
senses.definitionCN: 说话或做事干脆利落，没有多余的话
senses.example: The coach gave a crisp answer to every question.
senses.exampleCN: 教练对每个问题都给出了干脆的回答。
senses.why: A snap has no wobble, so speech without extra words is also crisp.
senses.whyCN: 脆响没有一点拖泥带水，所以没有废话的话语也是 crisp。

senses.title: To make or become firm and dry
senses.definition: to make food firm and dry by cooking, or to turn that way
senses.definitionCN: 通过烹饪使食物变干变脆，或指食物变脆的过程
senses.example: The bacon crisps nicely in the hot pan.
senses.exampleCN: 培根在热锅里煎得香脆。
senses.why: Cooking drives water out, leaving the snap behind, so the verb simply means to create the snap.
senses.whyCN: 烹饪把水分赶走，留下脆响，所以动词义就是制造脆响。

intro.en: Crisp traces back to Latin words about curly hair and stiffened surfaces.
intro.cn: crisp 可追溯到拉丁语中与卷发、挺硬表面相关的词。

items.en: The Latin crispus meant curly or stiff with tiny waves.
items.cn: 拉丁语 crispus 意为卷曲的、带细小波纹而硬挺的。

items.en: Old French kept cresp, meaning curly, and applied it to surfaces.
items.cn: 古法语保留 cresp，意为卷曲的，并用于描述表面。

items.en: English borrowed crisp in Old English times via Germanic contact, first about curly hair.
items.cn: 英语经由日耳曼接触在古英语时期借入 crisp，起初形容卷发。

items.en: The sense moved from curls to dry firm surfaces that snap.
items.cn: 词义从「卷曲」转向干燥挺硬、一折就断的表面。

items.en: Today crisp describes food, air, writing and even banknotes.
items.cn: 如今 crisp 形容食物、空气、文风甚至钞票。

note.en: These words share the crisp family or name snap and freshness.
note.cn: 这些词属于 crisp 词族，或表示脆响与清新。

entries.definition: in Britain, a thin potato snack

normalIntro.en: Sound and surface images fix crisp quickly.
normalIntro.cn: 声音与表面的意象能快速锁定 crisp。

normal.en: crisp sounds like its own snap: kr-i-sp.
normal.cn: crisp 的发音自带脆响：kr-i-sp。

normal.en: crispy = crisp + y, the food adjective.
normal.cn: crispy ＝ crisp + y，形容食物的常用变体。

normal.en: Crisp air means dry cool air, not sticky heat.
normal.cn: crisp air 指干爽凉气，不是闷热。

normal.en: A crisp reply answers with no extra words.
normal.cn: crisp reply 回答干脆，没有废话。

normal.en: In Britain, crisps are what Americans call chips.
normal.cn: 在英国 crisps 指薯片，即美式 chips。

abstract.en: Bite an apple and hear the tiny snap ring in your ears.
abstract.cn: 咬一口苹果，听那声脆响在耳边回荡。

abstract.en: Step outside on a January morning and feel the air pinch your cheeks.
abstract.cn: 在冬日清晨出门，感受空气轻掐脸颊的清冽。

abstract.en: See a new banknote folded flat, not one soft corner.
abstract.cn: 看一张挺括的新钞平整折好，没有一个软角。

examples.en: Grandma's biscuits come out of the oven golden and crisp.
examples.cn: 奶奶的饼干出炉时金黄酥脆。

examples.en: The morning air was crisp after last night's rain.
examples.cn: 夜雨过后，清晨的空气格外清爽。

examples.en: Our team captain gave a crisp speech before the game.
examples.cn: 队长赛前作了简短利落的发言。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「脆斯铺」——脆响一声「斯」地铺满口腔

root: 来自拉丁语 crispus（卷曲硬挺的），经古法语 cresp 进入英语；词义由「卷曲」演变为「干燥挺硬、一折即断」，故有脆、清爽、利落等义项。

sensesIntro.en: From a snapping bite to cool air to clipped words.
sensesIntro.cn: 从咬下的一声脆响，到清冽的空气，再到简短的话语。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a clean dry snap
core.cn: 核心意象：干脆的断裂声

branches.en: Autumn mornings full of fresh air
Food turning firm in the pan

intro.en: Crisp keeps a short Latin root and adds plain English endings.
intro.cn: crisp 保留简短的拉丁词根，加上朴素的英语词尾。

latinIntro.en: The Latin root crispus meant curly and stiff.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词根 crispus 意为卷曲而硬挺。

definition_zh: 十字；交叉；穿越；穿过；杂交
definition_en: a mark or shape of two crossing lines; to go from one side to the other
core_image: 两条线在路口相互穿过
scene: 放学路上，我们在人行横道前停下来，等绿灯亮起才走。Remember to look both ways before you cross the road.
sceneCN: 这里 cross 是「穿过；穿越」（第 2 个义项：从一边走到另一边）；句意是过马路前记得先两边看看。

derivatives.zh: 由动词加 -ing 构成，义为「交叉点；渡口；人行横道」
复合词，义为「人行横道」
复合词，义为「十字路口」
由 cross 加 -wise 构成，义为「交叉地」

senses.title: The shape or mark of two crossing lines
senses.definition: a mark or object shaped like the letter x or a plus sign, often a symbol
senses.definitionCN: 像字母 x 或加号形状的记号或物体，常用作符号
senses.example: She drew a small cross on the map to show our meeting place.
senses.exampleCN: 她在地图上画了个小十字，标出集合地点。
senses.why: The core image is two lines striking through each other, so the shape itself is a cross.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是两条线相互穿过，所以这个形状本身就是 cross。

senses.title: To go from one side to the other
senses.definition: to move from one side of a place, road or river to the other
senses.definitionCN: 从马路、河流等的一侧移动到另一侧
senses.example: Hold my hand while we cross the street.
senses.exampleCN: 过马路时牵着我的手。
senses.why: When you walk where two lines meet, you pass from one side to the other, so crossing lines became crossing places.
senses.whyCN: 走在两条线相交处时，你会从一侧到另一侧，所以交叉线引申出穿越义。

senses.title: To mix one line or kind with another
senses.definition: to put two kinds together, such as animals, plants or ideas
senses.definitionCN: 把两种东西放在一起，如动植物或想法
senses.example: Farmers cross two kinds of wheat to get better grain.
senses.exampleCN: 农民把两种小麦杂交以获得更好的谷物。
senses.why: Two lines meet and merge into one path, so two kinds joined become a cross.
senses.whyCN: 两条线相遇并汇成一条路，所以混合的两种事物也叫 cross。

senses.title: Angry or annoyed
senses.definition: slightly angry or annoyed, mainly in British English
senses.definitionCN: 有点生气或恼火，主要用于英式英语
senses.example: Mom was cross when she saw the messy room.
senses.exampleCN: 看到凌乱的房间，妈妈生气了。
senses.why: Some say a frown draws crossing lines on the forehead, which may link the mood to the shape; the link is a guess.
senses.whyCN: 有人说皱眉会在额头画交叉线，也许因此把情绪和形状联系起来；这只是一种猜测。

intro.en: Cross travelled from Latin through Old Norse into English.
intro.cn: cross 从拉丁语经古诺斯语传入英语。

items.en: The Latin crux meant a cross, a frame or stake, later a hard point of a problem.
items.cn: 拉丁语 crux 意为十字架、刑架，后指问题的难点。

items.en: Old Norse brought kross to England with the early church.
items.cn: 古诺斯语把 kross 随早期基督教带到英格兰。

items.en: Old English used cros for the Christian symbol.
items.cn: 古英语用 cros 指基督教的十字符号。

items.en: The verb sense of going across and the mixed-line sense grew from the shape.
items.cn: 穿越与混合的动词义由这个形状发展而来。

items.en: Modern speech adds the angry sense and many compounds like crosswalk.
items.cn: 现代口语增加了生气的义项和 crosswalk 等复合词。

note.en: These words share the cross family or meet its shape idea.
note.cn: 这些词属于 cross 词族，或与交叉形状相关。

entries.definition: a place where two roads cross
the central point of a problem
from one side to the other

normalIntro.en: One shape idea branches into all the cross senses.
normalIntro.cn: 一个形状意象分叉出 cross 的所有义项。

normal.en: Two lines strike through each other: the shape is a cross.
normal.cn: 两条线相互穿过：这个形状就是十字。

normal.en: cross the road: you travel along one crossing line.
normal.cn: cross the road：你沿其中一条交叉线走过去。

normal.en: cross out: draw a line through wrong words.
normal.cn: cross out：在错词上画线划掉。

normal.en: Cross two plants: their lines of family meet.
normal.cn: cross 两种植物：它们的家族线相交。

normal.en: across keeps the same root with a- in front.
normal.cn: across 是同根词，前面加了 a-。

abstract.en: Stand at a zebra crossing and watch two white lines pass under your feet.
abstract.cn: 站在斑马线上，看两条白色线从脚下穿过。

abstract.en: Draw a plus sign, then walk it as if it were a street corner.
abstract.cn: 画一个加号，然后把它当作街角走一遍。

abstract.en: Picture two family lines of wheat merging into one field.
abstract.cn: 想象两条小麦家族线汇成同一片田。

examples.en: We waited at the crosswalk, then crossed safely.
examples.cn: 我们在人行横道等灯，然后安全穿过马路。

examples.en: Cross out the wrong answer and write again.
examples.cn: 把错误答案划掉再重写。

examples.en: Don't be cross; we can fix the model together.
examples.cn: 别生气，我们可以一起把模型修好。

root: 来自拉丁语 crux（十字架、刑架），经古诺斯语 kross 与古英语 cros 进入英语；核心意象是「两条线相互穿过」，引申出穿越、杂交等义。

sensesIntro.en: One crossing shape gives a mark, a movement, a mix and even a mood.
sensesIntro.cn: 一个交叉形状给出记号、动作、混合甚至情绪。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two lines striking through each other
core.cn: 核心意象：两条线相互穿过

branches.en: Marks, signs and the red cross

branches.cn: 被穿过的马路、河流与桥

branches.en: Both mean moving through or mixing lines
branches.cn: 都表示穿越或混合线条

intro.en: Cross forms many place compounds with a plain root.
intro.cn: cross 以朴素的词根构成许多地点复合词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin root crux meant a crossing frame.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词根 crux 意为交叉的架形。

definition_en: a large group of people close together; to fill a space with too many people or things
core_image: 体育场门口涌动的人潮
scene: 校运会开幕式上，操场四周站满了挥舞小旗的同学。A big crowd gathered to watch the relay race.
sceneCN: 这里 crowd 是「人群」（第 1 个义项：密集聚在一起的一群人）；句意是一大群人聚在一起观看接力赛。

derivatives.zh: 由动词加 -ed 构成，义为「拥挤的」
由动词加 -ing 构成，义为「拥挤；聚集」
由 crowded 加 -ness 构成，义为「拥挤程度」

senses.title: A large group of people together
senses.definition: many people gathered close together in one place
senses.definitionCN: 许多人密集地聚在同一地方
senses.example: The crowd cheered when the runners crossed the line.
senses.exampleCN: 选手冲线时人群欢呼起来。
senses.why: The core image is many bodies pressed into one space, so any dense group is a crowd.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是许多身体挤在同一空间，所以任何密集的人群都是 crowd。

senses.title: To fill a space with too much
senses.definition: to fill a place completely, often too completely
senses.definitionCN: 把一个地方完全填满，常常太满
senses.example: Too many desks crowd the small classroom.
senses.exampleCN: 太多课桌把小教室挤得满满的。
senses.why: When the group presses into a room, the room itself is said to be crowded by them.
senses.whyCN: 当人群挤进房间时，就说房间被他们挤满了。

senses.title: To press close around someone
senses.definition: to gather closely around a person or thing
senses.definitionCN: 紧紧围在某人或某物周围
senses.example: Fans crowded around the singer for photos.
senses.exampleCN: 歌迷们围住歌手拍照。
senses.why: The mass moves as one toward its centre of attention, so surrounding someone is crowding.
senses.whyCN: 人群朝焦点整体移动，所以围住某人就是 crowding。

intro.en: Crowd first named a pressing instrument, then the pressing itself.
intro.cn: crowd 最初指一种挤压器具，后来才指挤压本身。

items.en: The Old English crudan meant to press or thrust, like a fiddle bow.
items.cn: 古英语 crudan 意为推挤，也与提琴弓相关。

items.en: It came from a Germanic root about pushing, shared with Dutch kruden.
items.cn: 它来自日耳曼语中表示推挤的词根，与荷兰语 kruden 同源。

items.en: The verb crowden meant to press forward in a mass.
items.cn: 中古英语动词 crowden 意为成群向前挤。

items.en: The noun crowd then named the mass of people doing the pressing.
items.cn: 名词 crowd 随之指正在挤压的人群。

items.en: Today crowd names groups, full buses and fan circles alike.
items.cn: 如今 crowd 指人群、满员的公交车和歌迷圈。

note.en: These words share the crowd family or name groups of people.
note.cn: 这些词属于 crowd 词族，或指人群。

entries.definition: a royal head cover; spelled a bit alike, different root
entries.definitionCN: 王冠（拼写略近，词源不同）

entries.definition: to bend low; sounds similar, different root
entries.definitionCN: 蹲下（读音相近，词源不同）

entries.definition: a tight group, also of animals
a moving mass, often insects or people

normalIntro.en: The pressing root and daily places hold crowd in place.
normalIntro.cn: 「推挤」词根与日常场所让 crowd 落位。

normal.en: crowd = press: many bodies pushing into one space.
normal.cn: crowd ＝推挤：许多身体挤进一个空间。

normal.en: crowd + ed = crowded, full of people.
normal.cn: crowd + ed ＝ crowded，人满为患的。

normal.en: A crowd of fans is smaller than a crowd of strangers.
normal.cn: a crowd of fans 比 a crowd of strangers 更有序。

normal.en: crowd around: form a ring around the star.
normal.cn: crowd around：围着明星围成一圈。

normal.en: The bus is crowded at seven every morning.
normal.cn: 公交车每天早上七点都很挤。

abstract.en: Hear the wave of cheers roll from the stands at the sports meet.
abstract.cn: 听运动会看台上欢呼的声浪滚过。

abstract.en: Feel the squeeze of the school bus at gate time.
abstract.cn: 感受校门口上车时的挤压。

abstract.en: See red scarves bob in one sea of heads at the flag-raising.
abstract.cn: 看升旗时一片红领巾在人海中起伏。

examples.en: The crowd waved little flags at the opening ceremony.
examples.cn: 人群在开幕式上挥舞着小旗。

examples.en: Don't crowd the door; let people out first.
examples.cn: 别挤在门口，先让人出去。

examples.en: The street was crowded with shoppers before Spring Festival.
examples.cn: 春节前街上挤满了购物的人。

sensesIntro.en: From pressing bodies, to full rooms, to rings around a star.
sensesIntro.cn: 从推挤的身体，到爆满的房间，再到围绕明星的人圈。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: many bodies pressed into one space
core.cn: 核心意象：许多身体挤进同一空间

branches.en: Fans and runners at a sports meet
branches.cn: 运动会上的观众与选手

branches.en: The mass moves toward its centre

intro.en: Crowd is a plain Germanic root with simple endings.
intro.cn: crowd 是朴素的日耳曼词根，词尾也简单。

latinIntro.en: Crowd is Germanic, not Latin, so latinEntries stay empty.

definition_zh: 残忍的；残酷的；令人痛苦的
definition_en: causing pain or suffering on purpose; unkind and without pity
core_image: 明知对方会疼，仍然下重手
scene: 读童话时，我心疼那个被迫整夜干活的灰姑娘。The cruel stepmother made her do all the housework.
sceneCN: 这里 cruel 是「残忍的」（第 1 个义项：故意让人受苦）；句意是残忍的继母让她做全部家务。

derivatives.zh: 由 cruel 加名词后缀构成，义为「残忍；残酷行为」
由 cruel 加副词后缀构成，义为「残忍地」
较少用的名词形式，义为「残忍」

senses.title: Causing pain on purpose
senses.definition: hurting people or animals and enjoying it or not caring
senses.definitionCN: 伤害人或动物，且以此为乐或毫不在意
senses.example: It is cruel to laugh at a classmate's mistake.
senses.exampleCN: 嘲笑同学的错误是残忍的。
senses.why: The core image is a hand that presses even when the other side cries out, so willing harm is cruel.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是明知对方哭喊仍按下去的手，所以有意伤害就是 cruel。

senses.title: Harsh and hard to bear
senses.definition: causing suffering without intending any single person harm
senses.definitionCN: 带来苦难，但不针对某个具体的人
senses.example: The team lost the final in the last second, a cruel result.
senses.exampleCN: 球队在最后一秒输掉决赛，结果太残酷了。
senses.why: The same press can come from fate or weather, so outcomes and conditions wear the word too.
senses.whyCN: 同样的「按压」也可能来自命运或天气，所以结果与境况也可以用这个词。

intro.en: Cruel comes from Latin through French, built on blood and heart.
intro.cn: cruel 经法语来自拉丁语，建立在「血」与「心」之上。

items.en: The Latin crudelis came from crudus, meaning raw blood or unfeeling.
items.cn: 拉丁语 crudelis 来自 crudus，意为生血或冷酷无情。

items.en: Old French carried it as cruel, meaning hard-hearted.
items.cn: 古法语将其变为 cruel，意为铁石心肠的。

items.en: English borrowed cruel in the thirteenth century for merciless people.
items.cn: 英语在十三世纪借入 cruel，形容无情的人。

items.en: Its noun cruelty named both the feeling and the acts.
items.cn: 名词 cruelty 既指这种心态，也指具体行为。

items.en: Cruel now covers people, jokes, weather and fate.
items.cn: 如今 cruel 可形容人、玩笑、天气与命运。

note.en: These words share the cruel family or name harsh behaviour.
note.cn: 这些词属于 cruel 词族，或指严酷的行为。

entries.definition: cruel treatment or a cruel act

entries.definitionCN: 严厉的； harsh conditions 恶劣的

normalIntro.en: The raw-blood root and the family endings fix cruel.
normalIntro.cn: 「生血」词根与词族后缀锁定 cruel。

normal.en: crudus = raw blood: hard hearts were called raw-blooded.
normal.cn: crudus ＝生血：铁石心肠被称作「生血般的」。

normal.en: cruel + ty = cruelty, the act or feeling.
normal.cn: cruel + ty ＝ cruelty，残忍或残酷行为。

normal.en: cruel + ly = cruelly, the adverb.
normal.cn: cruel + ly ＝ cruelly，副词。

normal.en: Be cruel to animals is the fixed phrase to avoid.
normal.cn: be cruel to animals 是要避免的固定说法。

normal.en: Crude shares the raw idea but means rough, not mean.
normal.cn: crude 同源，指粗糙，不指刻薄。

abstract.en: Hear a laugh aimed at someone who just stumbled.
abstract.cn: 听一声冲着摔倒同学发出的嘲笑。

abstract.en: See a ball bounce the wrong way at the last second of the final.
abstract.cn: 看决赛最后一秒球弹向错误方向。

abstract.en: Feel icy wind walk through a thin jacket on the way to school.
abstract.cn: 感受上学路上寒风穿透薄外套。

examples.en: Stop that cruel joke; it really hurts her feelings.
examples.cn: 别开那个伤人的玩笑，真的伤了她的心。

examples.en: The cruel wind froze our fingers on the way home.
examples.cn: 回家路上寒风冻僵了我们的手指。

examples.en: People who are cruel to animals should be stopped.
examples.cn: 虐待动物的人应该被制止。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「克鲁尔」——克扣别人温暖的「鲁莽」之手

root: 来自拉丁语 crudelis（源于 crudus「生的、生血、无情的」），经古法语 cruel 进入英语；核心意象是「不因怜悯而收回的手」。

sensesIntro.en: From willing harm to hard fates and biting weather.
sensesIntro.cn: 从有意伤害，到残酷的命运与刺骨的天气。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand that does not stop when others cry
core.cn: 核心意象：别人哭喊也不停下的手

branches.cn: 被称作残酷的失利与风暴
作为可举报行为的虐待

branches.en: Cruel weather on the way home

branches.cn: 同一只冷手，不同的受害者

intro.en: Cruel adds plain endings to a Latin rawness root.
intro.cn: cruel 在拉丁「生」词根上添加朴素词尾。

latinIntro.en: The Latin root crudus means raw or unfeeling.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词根 crudus 意为生的、无情的。

definition_en: to shed tears, often with sound; to shout or call out loudly
core_image: 眼泪冲出眼眶、声音从喉咙冲出
scene: 运动会接力赛输了，队友们都红了眼眶，可谁也没放弃下一场。She wanted to cry when she missed the last basket.
sceneCN: 这里 cry 是「哭」（第 1 个义项：流出眼泪并常带哭声）；句意是她投丢最后一球时想哭。

collocations.zh: 为无法挽回的事哭泣（谚语）

derivatives.zh: 由动词加 -ing 构成，义为「哭着的；紧急的」
由 cry 加 baby 构成，义为「爱哭的人」
由 out 加 cry 构成，义为「强烈抗议」

senses.title: To shed tears from feeling
senses.definition: to let tears fall because you are sad, hurt or even overjoyed
senses.definitionCN: 因伤心、受伤甚至过度高兴而让眼泪落下
senses.example: The little boy cried when his balloon flew away.
senses.exampleCN: 气球飞走时，小男孩哭了。
senses.why: The core image is tears bursting out when feelings overflow, so strong emotion makes people cry.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是情感满溢时眼泪夺眶而出，所以强烈的情绪让人 cry。

senses.title: To shout loudly
senses.definition: to call out in a loud voice, often to warn or attract attention
senses.definitionCN: 大声呼喊，常为了提醒或引人注意
senses.example: Watch out! she cried as the ball flew over.
senses.exampleCN: 球飞过来时她大喊：小心！
senses.why: The same burst that pushes tears out can push sound out, so the voice cry joins the tear cry.
senses.whyCN: 把眼泪冲出来的那股爆发力也能把声音冲出来，所以声音的呼喊与眼泪的哭共用一词。

senses.title: A loud call or slogan
senses.definition: a loud sound, shout or slogan heard from a person or a group
senses.definitionCN: 个人或群体发出的响亮喊声或口号
senses.example: We heard the cry of vendors selling hot potatoes outside the stadium.
senses.exampleCN: 我们听见体育场外卖烤红薯小贩的叫卖声。
senses.why: When many voices rise together, each burst becomes a cry that can be heard and even written down.
senses.whyCN: 当许多声音一齐响起时，每次爆发都成为可听见甚至可记录的 cry。

intro.en: Cry came through French from a Latin word about outcry and prayer.
intro.cn: cry 经法语来自拉丁语中与呼喊、祈祷相关的词。

items.en: The Latin quiritare meant to shriek, said to come from calling on the Quirites, Roman citizens, for help.
items.cn: 拉丁语 quiritare 意为尖叫，一般认为源自向罗马公民（Quirites）呼救。

items.en: Old French carried it as crier, meaning to shout or proclaim.
items.cn: 古法语将其变为 crier，意为喊叫、宣告。

items.en: English borrowed crien in the thirteenth century for loud calls.
items.cn: 英语在十三世纪借入 crien，指大声呼喊。

items.en: The tearful sense grew beside the shouting sense.
items.cn: 流泪义在喊叫义旁边生长出来。

items.en: Today cry covers tears, shouts, slogans and street calls.
items.cn: 如今 cry 覆盖眼泪、喊叫、口号与街头叫卖。

note.en: These words share the cry family or name tears and shouts.
note.cn: 这些词属于 cry 词族，或指眼泪与喊叫。

without water; only spelled a bit alike
to cry with a long sad sound

normalIntro.en: One burst image covers tears and shouts.
normalIntro.cn: 一个「爆发」意象覆盖眼泪与喊叫。

normal.en: cry sounds like its own burst: kr-eye.
normal.cn: cry 的发音自带爆发感：kr-eye。

normal.en: cry + ed = cried, the simple past.
normal.cn: cry + ed ＝ cried，过去式把 y 变 i。

normal.en: cry for help is the fixed rescue phrase.
normal.cn: cry for help 是固定的呼救短语。

normal.en: Cry over spilt milk means useless tears.
normal.cn: cry over spilt milk 指无用的眼泪。

normal.en: weep is the calm book word, cry the everyday word.
normal.cn: weep 是书面词，cry 是日常词。

abstract.en: Feel the hot lump rise in your throat before tears fall.
abstract.cn: 感受眼泪落下前喉咙里的热块。

abstract.en: Hear a watchman's voice ring across the quiet street.
abstract.cn: 听守夜人的声音在安静的街道回荡。

abstract.en: See one word shouted by a hundred fans as one slogan.
abstract.cn: 看百名球迷把一个词喊成口号。

examples.en: The film's ending was so touching that many of us cried.
examples.cn: 电影结尾太感人，我们许多人都哭了。

examples.en: He heard a cry for help from the swimming pool.
examples.cn: 他听到游泳池传来呼救声。

examples.en: Don't cry over the broken vase; it was an accident.
examples.cn: 别为打碎的花瓶哭了，那只是个意外。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「哭爱」——眼泪「哭」着冲出，爱哭的人最「爱」喊

root: 一般认为来自拉丁语 quiritare（尖叫，或与向罗马公民呼救有关），经古法语 crier 进入英语；核心意象是「情绪或声音的突然爆发」。

sensesIntro.en: One burst covers tears, shouts and street calls.
sensesIntro.cn: 一次爆发覆盖眼泪、喊叫与街头叫卖。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: feelings bursting out as tears or sound
core.cn: 核心意象：情绪以眼泪或声音爆发

branches.en: Tears at sad films and lost games
branches.cn: 伤感电影与失利比赛的眼泪
写在横幅上的公开呼声

intro.en: Cry builds loud-family compounds with simple parts.
intro.cn: cry 用简单部件构成「响亮家族」复合词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin root quiritare meant to shriek for help.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词根 quiritare 意为呼救尖叫。
